status: Provisional editorial families for the six vehicle files, not resolved buildability or full gameplay equivalence.

notes.china/CHTRUK: Inherits TRUK outside the surveyed faction files; classify availability/purpose before counting as a vehicle family.
notes.gdi/MDRN.Attached: Attached mini-drone helper is not an independently designed vehicle.
notes.soviet/TTNK.RA2: Heavy Tesla is a distinct hull, not just a named upgrade of the light Tesla truck.
notes.allies/2TNK: Disabled parent of the buildable Challenger/Leclerc/Leopard variants; the family remains relevant.
notes.allies/BATF: Disabled base prototype, but active Bunker/Artillery family variants remain relevant.
notes.allies/Prismtank: Prism Blaster and Prism Cannon are grouped as specialization branches, not lost or claimed equivalent.
notes.soviet/SFTNK: Locally disabled legacy prototype; excluded from the main family count when no production candidate exists.
